confidence_notes: The latest Malacca city-price panel is a proxy for the July 2026 window and reports only 16 contributors, so food and drink estimates have some uncertainty. Cocktail pricing follows local bar prices relative to beer; wine by the glass is less certain. Accommodation estimates are inferred from the supplied Malaysian comparables.
comparable_city_reasoning: Malacca’s year-typical accommodation is likely near Ipoh and Penang: its heritage tourism supports steady demand, while its urban hotel market is less resort-driven than Langkawi. I estimate basic rooms and hostel options near the lower end of those comparables and three-star rooms near Ipoh and Penang.
